title: Solid Orange
intro: Go Tigers! 🐯 Warm up the brain — and maybe the old 486.

puzzles.prompt: Clemson won its first football national championship in which season?
puzzles.explanation: The 1981 Tigers, coached by Danny Ford, went 12–0 and beat Nebraska 22–15 in the Orange Bowl.

puzzles.prompt: Howard’s Rock, which players rub before running down the Hill, came from where?
puzzles.explanation: It was brought from Death Valley, CA and presented to coach Frank Howard in the 1960s.

puzzles.prompt: Which SQL clause filters groups AFTER aggregation?
puzzles.explanation: WHERE filters rows before GROUP BY; HAVING filters the grouped results — e.g. HAVING COUNT(*) > 1.
